snippet.title: Combolands Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcing COMBOLANDS, a deckbuilder where your cards are buildings and the map is your deck. From the designer of Terra Nil!

🃏Stack combos
🏛️Grow your settlement
💥Break the game

Use outrageous builds to create a city that stands the test of time. Demo out now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4075620/Combolands/
